usage.finalMessage:
I added the `move <appointment> <date> <time>` command. It uses the booking rules and errors, `help` lists it right after `cancel`, and `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes (6 of 6, including my new test). The work and the report are committed.
A moved appointment doesn't block itself, so moving it to a nearby time or its own slot succeeds; that was my call, not the requirement's.
Moves also inherit an existing exemption that lets clinician k2 be double-booked, which decision DEC-C02 doesn't allow; I've raised it as an open question in the report.
OUTCOME: completed
